description: This file defines React functional components for a cybersecurity dashboard interface, including a Workflow stepper and a Data Progress panel, with state management hooks and UI elements.

methods.name: WorkflowStepper
methods.description: Component displaying the workflow progress with controls to start and reset the workflow.
